style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot; warm cream beige paper studio backdrop #F3E9DC with matte plaster white display blocks #F7F4EE for benefit, scene and infographic screens; clean light board #FAF7F2 for macro screens

style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle with a consistent pair scale across the set; single shoe for macro and spec screens; the product is always grounded by a real contact shadow and the metal hardware and upper grain always rendered true to material
